projects.title: Amazon Analysis — E‑commerce Insights
projects.subtitle: Business Analytics | Performance drivers and customer patterns
projects.bodyHtml:
Overview

Analyzed Amazon data to uncover revenue and margin drivers, customer behavior patterns, and product opportunities. Built a clear narrative of seasonality, cohort retention, and pricing impacts to guide decision‑making.

Data

  • Orders, items, customers, and product metadata.
  • Derived features for cohorts, repeat behavior, and contribution margins.

Methods

  • SQL for transformation and KPIs; Python for exploratory analysis.
  • Time‑series decomposition and cohort analysis for retention and LTV.
  • Segmentation to highlight high‑value products and customers.

Insights

  • Identified SKUs and segments with outsized contribution to revenue.
  • Surfaced seasonality and promo impacts guiding inventory and pricing.

How to Run

  1. Clone the repo and follow setup instructions in README.
  2. Load sample data and execute notebooks/SQL scripts.

projects.title: Pavement NDE QA System — Retrieval‑Augmented Generation
projects.subtitle: Data Scientist | FAISS, Transformers, Evaluation
projects.bodyHtml:
Overview

Engineered a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation system to answer questions about Non‑Destructive Evaluation (NDE) technologies. The solution embeds and indexes a corpus of standards and technical PDFs, retrieves the most relevant chunks using FAISS, and generates grounded answers with citations using transformer LMs.

Corpus

  • 20+ documents spanning 32 NDE technologies (standards, reports, guidance).
  • Pre‑processed with PDF text extraction, section detection, and chunking.

Methods

  • Vector index: FAISS (IVF/Flat) with sentence embeddings.
  • LMs: BERT/GPT‑2/Llama 3 variants evaluated for answer quality and latency.
  • Grounding: top‑k retrieval with source citations; heuristic reranking.

Results

  • Fast, source‑grounded answers with traceable citations.
  • Reduced time‑to‑insight for engineers; improved knowledge discoverability.

How to Run

  1. Clone repo and install dependencies (Python 3.10+).
  2. Prepare document directory and run ingest.py to build FAISS index.
  3. Start app.py and query via UI or CLI.

projects.title: U.S. Census Data Analysis — SQL EDA
projects.subtitle: Data Analyst | Joins, Window Functions, Reusable Views
projects.bodyHtml:
Overview

Exploratory data analysis of U.S. Census metrics using SQL to derive consistent, comparable insights across demographics, unemployment, poverty, and income distributions.

Modeling & Queries

  • Dimensional joins and CTE‑based pipelines to standardize metrics.
  • Window functions to compute moving averages and ranking.
  • Parameterized filters and views to support repeatable analysis.

Insights

  • Regional disparities surfaced with robust comparisons over time.
  • Clear narrative summaries to guide follow‑up analysis and visualization.

How to Run

  1. Load raw tables (CSV/DB) and execute provided SQL scripts in order.
  2. Query final views for charts or export to BI tools.

projects.title: Physician Allocation Optimization — Operations Analytics
projects.subtitle: Business Analyst | Capacity Planning, Throughput, Scenarios
projects.bodyHtml:
Overview

Balanced clinic capacity and demand by analyzing arrivals, no‑shows, and cycle times, then designing staffing scenarios aligned to throughput and SLA targets.

Data

  • Operational logs over ~6 months with schedule/visit metadata.
  • Derived features for load, utilization, and wait time distributions.

Approach

  • Time‑series profiling; bottleneck identification and what‑if scenarios.
  • Actionable allocation plan with quantified tradeoffs.

Outcomes

  • Improved utilization and reduced average wait times.

projects.title: World Energy Consumption — Tableau Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Business Intelligence | KPIs, Drill‑downs, Storytelling
projects.bodyHtml:
Overview

Interactive dashboard for exploring decades of global energy consumption, enabling comparison by country, source, and time with performant extracts and clear annotations.

Features

  • KPIs and trend lines for high‑level monitoring.
  • Drill‑downs by country and energy source with slicers.
  • Notes and context for data storytelling.

Tech

  • Tableau Desktop/Server; extract optimization; calculated fields.
